reason: The README describes a WebSocket browser bridge that lets CLI and MCP clients automate real browser tabs, interact with page elements, execute JavaScript, scrape content, and perform web searches.

summaries.zh: 通过 WebSocket 将本地 CLI 或 MCP 工具连接到真实浏览器，以执行标签页管理、页面交互、内容抓取和网页搜索。
summaries.en: Connects local CLI or MCP tools to a real browser over WebSocket for tab management, page interaction, content scraping, and web searches.

capabilities: Clicks, types, selects, checks, and scrolls page elements
Executes arbitrary JavaScript in web pages
Scrapes structured page data and page content
Reads accessibility trees and element values
Exposes browser commands through a CLI and MCP server
Performs searches and retrieves data from external websites
